## 2. Professional Biography & Summary
Alfian Nur Usyaid is a passionate and detail-oriented Fullstack Developer with extensive experience in architecting modern web applications, scalable backend APIs, interactive user interfaces, and decentralized blockchain systems. 

He holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from STT Terpadu Nurul Fikri with a near-perfect GPA of 3.94 (Graduated with Honors / Cumlaude). Throughout his academic and professional journey, Alfian has served as a university Teaching Assistant across multiple core computer science domains (Data Structures & Algorithms, Relational Databases, and Backend Web Development), while actively contributing to cutting-edge research projects involving AI-driven essay assessment and decentralized Web3 storage architectures.

## 3. Technical Skills & Proficiencies

### Core Programming Languages
- **JavaScript (ES6+) & TypeScript**: Advanced proficiency in type-safe development, asynchronous programming, and modern ECMAScript standards.

- **Solidity**: Smart contract development, cryptographic proof-of-storage, and EVM decentralized application logic.
- **SQL**: Relational database schema design, indexing, and complex query optimization.

### Frontend Technologies
- **Next.js (App Router, Turbopack)**: Server-side rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), dynamic route handlers, SEO metadata, and React Server Components.
- **React 19**: Modern hooks, context API, functional components, state management, and performance optimization.
- **Tailwind CSS (v4)**: Responsive utility-first design systems, custom design tokens, dark/light theme switching, and fluid typography.
- **HTML5 & CSS3**: Semantic web standards, accessibility (a11y), responsive layouts, and cross-browser compatibility.

### Backend & API Engineering
- **Laravel (PHP)**: RESTful API design, Eloquent ORM, authentication (Sanctum), middleware, and MVC design pattern.
- **Flask (Python)**: Decoupled AI integration servers, LangChain LLM pipelines, and geospatial computation.
- **Express.js (Node.js)**: Modular MVC, DAO patterns, parameterized MySQL queries, and middleware pipelines.

### Databases & Storage
- **MySQL / MariaDB**: Relational schema design, query optimization, normalization, and stored procedures.
- **PostgreSQL**: Advanced relational features, indexing, and transactional integrity.
- **MongoDB**: NoSQL document modeling and aggregation pipelines.
- **IPFS (InterPlanetary File System)**: Decentralized peer-to-peer storage and content addressing.

### Tools & Methodologies

- **Testing**: Vitest, React Testing Library, fast-check (Property-Based Testing), and Jest.
- **Design & Prototyping**: Figma, UI/UX wireframing, and component design systems.

## 5. Featured Projects

### 1. RoadSense (Smart GIS Navigation & Road Damage Mapping)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15, tRPC (T3 Stack), Leaflet, Flask (Python), Shapely, OSRM Routing
- **Repository**: https://github.com/LIan2nd/RoadSense
- **Description**: A crowdsourced Geographic Information System (GIS) platform enabling citizens to report and visualize road damage in real time, featuring intelligent alternative route calculation to avoid severely damaged roads.

### 2. DigiArc (Web3 Decentralized Cloud Storage)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Wagmi, Solidity Smart Contracts, IPFS
- **Live Demo**: https://digiarc.vercel.app
- **Description**: A decentralized alternative to Google Drive. Enables users to store, manage, and verify document authenticity on the blockchain via IPFS content addressing.

### 3. ESAO (AI-Powered Automated Essay Grading System)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Flask (Python), LangChain, AI LLM APIs
- **Live System**: https://esao.nurulfikri.ac.id
- **Description**: Automated exam assessment platform for educators that evaluates descriptive student answers against custom grading rubrics, providing instant scoring and personalized constructive feedback.

### 4. Event Management & Registration System
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Bootstrap, Blade MVC
- **Repository**: https://github.com/LIan2nd/sistem-pendaftaran-event
- **Description**: Multi-role event registration and participant ticketing platform with secure user authentication, CRUD operations, and event analytics.

### 5. Chicken Yasaka (E-Commerce Web)
- **Tech Stack**: Python (Flask), jQuery (AJAX), Bootstrap 5, Jinja2, MongoDB/MySQL
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MuhamadMudrikaRidho/web_chicken_yaska
- **Description**: Full-stack e-commerce web platform for poultry sales developed as the final project for MSIB Kampus Merdeka with LearningX. Features product catalogs, dynamic cart management, user authentication, and an admin dashboard.

### 6. HRD RESTful API
- **Tech Stack**: Express.js, Node.js, MySQL
- **Repository**: https://github.com/LIan2nd/uas-pemrograman-backend
- **Description**: Enterprise-grade human resources backend service utilizing clean MVC and OOP architectures, class-based controllers, DAO models, and parameterized SQL queries.

## 6. Academic Research & Publications
- **Paper Title**: *Model Prediksi Retensi Mahasiswa Berbasis Random Forest Yang Dioptimasi Dengan Algoritma Genetika* (Student Retention Prediction Model Based on Genetic Algorithm-Optimized Random Forest with SMOTE)
- **Authors**: Pudy Prima, Ahmad Rio Adriansyah, Alfian Nur Usyaid
- **Journal**: MIND Journal (Vol 11, No 1, 2026), Institut Teknologi Nasional Bandung (ITENAS)
- **Publication Link**: https://ejurnal.itenas.ac.id/index.php/mindjournal/article/view/15673
- **Summary**: Addressed severe class imbalance in academic student retention datasets using SMOTE, combined with Genetic Algorithm hyperparameter optimization over Random Forest classifiers, achieving significant gains in predictive accuracy.
